description: List off-plan projects from the site catalogue. Filter by area, developer, budget, handover year or free text. Returns name, developer, area, starting price, handover, unit types and the page URL. Sold-out projects are excluded unless include_sold_out is true.

area.description: Area name e.g. "Al Marjan Island", "Mina Al Arab", "RAK Central"

include_sold_out.description: Include projects flagged sold out. Default false.

lang.description: Language of the answer. Default en.

limit.description: Max results, default 5, hard cap 25. ALWAYS request 5 unless visitor explicitly asks for more.

query.description: Free text matched against project, developer and area names (e.g. "beachfront", "branded residence")

name: list_projects
title: Find off-plan projects in Ras Al Khaimah
